summary_zh: 共享报告串行化、旧观测拒绝、部分发布保护和Windows实际字节hash修复通过独立审核。
summary_en: Independent review approves shared-report serialization, stale-observation rejection, partial-publication protection and Windows actual-byte hashing.
limitations_zh: 跨文件不是事务；失败后以同一不可变且仍有效的认证回执显式重放恢复，或新有效回执恢复。无回执CLI对未完成发布明确UNKNOWN，不自动伪造认证。人工写者需同锁。未验证生产或真实多心跳C3。
limitations_en: Publication is not a cross-file transaction. Explicit replay of the same still-valid immutable authenticated receipt, or a newer valid receipt, repairs partial publication. No-receipt CLI marks incomplete publication UNKNOWN without inventing authentication. Manual writers must cooperate with the lock. Production and real multi-heartbeat C3 were not validated.
